newsitem.title: USA: Firm has 5.0 pct Firstcity Financial stake.
newsitem.headline: Firm has 5.0 pct Firstcity Financial stake.

text.p: Constable Asset Management, a Radnor, Pa., investment adviser, said on Friday it holds a 5.0036 percent stake in Firstcity Financial Corp.

In a filing with the Securities and Exchange Commission, Constable said it bought 123,139 shares of FirstCity Financial between May 1 and August 21 at prices ranging from $19.07 to $22.90 a share or $2.74 million. Constable said it acquired the shares for investment purposes.
